solutions.brackets.depth: CHARS [ 'C' BIND 1 -1 C '(' EQ NOT C '[' EQ NOT AND NOT SELECT ] MAP 0 [ ADD ] SCAN 0 [ MAX ] FOLD
solutions.brackets.balanced: CHARS [ '#' ] [ 'C' BIND 'A' BIND A -1 DROP A C 1 COLLECT CONCAT 2 COLLECT 0 1 A -1 GET 'T' BIND C ')' EQ T '(' EQ AND NOT C ']' EQ T '[' EQ AND NOT AND NOT SELECT GET ] FOLD LENGTH 1 EQ
solutions.brackets.balanced_prefix: CHARS [ '#' ] [ 'C' BIND 'A' BIND A -1 DROP A C 1 COLLECT CONCAT 2 COLLECT 0 1 A -1 GET 'T' BIND C ')' EQ T '(' EQ AND NOT C ']' EQ T '[' EQ AND NOT AND NOT SELECT GET ] SCAN [ 0 0 ] [ LENGTH 2 LT 'T' BIND [ 'P' 'B' ] BIND P 1 ADD 'Q' BIND Q Q B T SELECT 2 COLLECT ] FOLD 1 GET
solutions.brackets.unmatched: CHARS [ '#' ] [ 'C' BIND 'A' BIND A -1 DROP A C 1 COLLECT CONCAT 2 COLLECT 0 1 A -1 GET 'T' BIND C ')' EQ T '(' EQ AND NOT C ']' EQ T '[' EQ AND NOT AND NOT SELECT GET ] FOLD LENGTH 1 SUB
solutions.ledger.by_name: ZIP [ 'NS' 'AS' ] BIND NS AS GROUP 'G' BIND G KEYS G VALUES [ G0A.SUM ] MAP RECORD
solutions.ledger.top_name: ZIP [ 'NS' 'AS' ] BIND NS AS GROUP 'G' BIND G VALUES [ G0A.SUM ] MAP 'V' BIND G KEYS V -1 MUL ORDER 0 GET GET
solutions.ledger.debtors: ZIP [ 'NS' 'AS' ] BIND NS AS GROUP 'G' BIND G KEYS G VALUES [ G0A.SUM ] MAP 2 COLLECT ZIP [ 1 GET 0 LT ] FILTER [ 0 GET ] MAP
solutions.ledger.largest_entry: 'E' BIND E E ZIP 1 GET -1 MUL ORDER 0 GET GET
solutions.messy.normalize: LOWER G0A.WORDS [ ' ' 2 COLLECT JOIN ] MAP JOIN TRIM
solutions.messy.top_word: LOWER G0A.WORDS TALLY 'T' BIND T KEYS T VALUES -1 MUL ORDER 0 GET GET
solutions.messy.title: LOWER G0A.WORDS [ CHARS 'CS' BIND CS 1 TAKE JOIN UPPER CS 1 DROP JOIN ' ' 3 COLLECT JOIN ] MAP JOIN TRIM
solutions.messy.sorted_unique: LOWER G0A.WORDS UNIQUE SORT [ ' ' 2 COLLECT JOIN ] MAP JOIN TRIM
solutions.prose.longest: ' ' TOKENIZE 'WS' BIND WS WS [ CHARS LENGTH ] MAP -1 MUL ORDER 0 GET GET
solutions.prose.freq_top: ' ' TOKENIZE TALLY 'T' BIND T KEYS T VALUES -1 MUL ORDER 0 GET GET
solutions.prose.distinct_sorted: ' ' TOKENIZE UNIQUE SORT [ ' ' 2 COLLECT JOIN ] MAP JOIN TRIM
solutions.prose.reverse_words: ' ' TOKENIZE REVERSE [ ' ' 2 COLLECT JOIN ] MAP JOIN TRIM
solutions.prose.capitalize: ' ' TOKENIZE [ CHARS 'CS' BIND CS 1 TAKE JOIN UPPER CS 1 DROP JOIN ' ' 3 COLLECT JOIN ] MAP JOIN TRIM
solutions.prose.initials_of_long: ' ' TOKENIZE [ CHARS LENGTH 3 GT ] FILTER [ CHARS 0 GET ] MAP JOIN UPPER
solutions.runs.rle: [ [ '#' 0 ] ] [ 'X' BIND 'A' BIND A -1 GET [ 'V' 'N' ] BIND A -1 DROP X N 1 ADD 2 COLLECT 1 COLLECT CONCAT A X 1 2 COLLECT 1 COLLECT CONCAT 2 COLLECT 0 1 V X EQ SELECT GET ] FOLD 1 DROP
solutions.runs.upruns: [ 0 0 0 ] [ 'X' BIND [ 'P' 'C' 'B' ] BIND X C 1 ADD 1 X P GT SELECT 'D' BIND D B D MAX 3 COLLECT ] FOLD 2 GET
solutions.runs.dedupe: [ '#' ] [ 'X' BIND 'A' BIND A A X 1 COLLECT CONCAT 2 COLLECT 0 1 A -1 GET X EQ SELECT GET ] FOLD 1 DROP
solutions.runs.majority: 'V' BIND V TALLY 'T' BIND T VALUES 'C' BIND C -1 MUL ORDER 0 GET 'I' BIND T KEYS I GET NIL C I GET 2 MUL V LENGTH GT SELECT
solutions.sensor.filled: 'V' BIND V V [ NIL? NOT ] FILTER 0 GET [ 'X' BIND 'A' BIND A X X NIL? SELECT ] SCAN
solutions.sensor.gap_count: [ NIL? ] MAP [ FALSE 0 ] [ 'M' BIND [ 'P' 'K' ] BIND M K 1 ADD K M P NOT AND SELECT 2 COLLECT ] FOLD 1 GET
solutions.sensor.longest_gap: [ NIL? ] MAP [ 0 0 ] [ 'M' BIND [ 'C' 'B' ] BIND C 1 ADD 0 M SELECT 'D' BIND D B D MAX 2 COLLECT ] FOLD 1 GET
solutions.sensor.ratios: 'V' BIND V 1 DROP V -1 DROP 2 COLLECT ZIP [ [ 'B' 'A' ] BIND B NIL? NOT A NIL? NOT AND NOT 'Q' BIND NIL 1 B Q SELECT 1 A Q SELECT DIV Q SELECT ] MAP
solutions.sensor.scaled: 'V' BIND V [ NIL? NOT ] FILTER G0D.MAXV 'M' BIND V [ 'X' BIND NIL X 1 X NIL? SELECT M DIV X NIL? SELECT ] MAP
solutions.series.median: SORT 'S' BIND S LENGTH 'N' BIND S N 1 SUB 2 DIV FLOOR GET S N 2 DIV FLOOR GET ADD 2 DIV
solutions.series.mad: 'V' BIND V SORT 'S' BIND S LENGTH 'N' BIND S N 1 SUB 2 DIV FLOOR GET S N 2 DIV FLOOR GET ADD 2 DIV 'M' BIND V M SUB 'D' BIND D D -1 MUL MAX SORT 'SD' BIND SD N 1 SUB 2 DIV FLOOR GET SD N 2 DIV FLOOR GET ADD 2 DIV
solutions.series.moving3: 'V' BIND V -2 DROP V 1 DROP -1 DROP V 2 DROP ADD ADD 3 DIV
solutions.series.runmax: 'V' BIND V V 0 GET [ MAX ] SCAN
solutions.series.mode: SORT TALLY 'T' BIND T KEYS T VALUES -1 MUL ORDER 0 GET GET
